about: Retries of the gapic client against scripted answers (script = the status of each call in order; OK = success). The probe keeps the default call options' retry codes and timeouts (call_options.json) but shortens the backoff to 1ms, since gax's pauses are random: only attempts (calls the server saw) and the final status are recorded. CreateWriteStream goes through createCommittedWriteStream, FinalizeWriteStream through the client. AppendRows: the server answers the scripted status as soon as the stream starts; open_status = the error of client.AppendRows(ctx) (grpc-go's NewStream does not wait for the server, so it is nil and gax's open retry never sees the status), status = the first Recv's error, send = the error of a Send made after that Recv (io.EOF on an ended stream; streamWriter.append drains Recv for the status when Send reports io.EOF).
